title: RingedRefinementModels
statement: For a scheme T and mode m (the ordinary small pro-etale site or its vertical sequence site), define presentation records for ring sheaves, their inverse images, exact module inverse images and open extensions, derived scalar extension, spatial and scalar compositors, clopen pullback shapes, open comparisons, and their refinement mates. Package m T bundles these data with their coefficient, spatial, refinement and shift equations. For constant finite coefficient rings define the section-preserving realization and its finite comparison and normalization records. These are precisely the definitions formerly accompanying lem-pur-ringed-refinement-coefficient-square; no notion or signature is changed.

source.place: 6.7.6–6.7.7, compactification independence; agent ordinary-derived ring-sheaf coefficient supplement to the clopen-section refinement construction, not a theorem literally asserted in the paper.
